prompt:
Generate one extremely polished high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE design comp for AOHYS. Exact canvas 1536 x 1024. This is a flat browser screenshot, not a photo of a screen or a poster. The design direction is PRODUCT ANATOMY: original, vibrant, mature, art-directed visual imagery that makes frontend craft AND software architecture tangible. This website presents one real senior software engineer, Alejandro Ortiz Corro, not an agency team. Make an authored composition with rich material and striking scale, while remaining clean, elegant and professionally readable.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1. Slim 84px neutral white navigation bar across the whole screen, generous edges: a distinctive custom lowercase 'aohys' wordmark left (provisional), 'Work' 'Architecture' 'Resume' 'Contact' right, discreet 'EN / ES'.
2. Main viewport from y100 to y775 is ONE asymmetric three-part composition, not cards. Left ~365px: 'Alejandro Ortiz Corro' then 'Senior Software Engineer'. Main headline in refined confidently-sized humanist sans, brown ink, 4 compact lines: 'I build software.\nFrom the interface\nto the systems\nbehind it.' No huge brutal block letters, no thin serif. A brief smaller line 'Frontend is my specialty. I work across the product.' A honey pill-like but precise 'Explore my work ↗' link and small 'View resume' text link. Keep lots of internal rhythm, not isolated floating text.
CENTER ~750px: stunning original 3D illustrated image MADE SPECIFICALLY FOR AOHYS, with warm honey, olive and apricot material at large scale. A physical exploded section of AOHYS's own SOFTWARE publishing product, viewed slightly from above in refined architectural product photography. Three thin, beautifully formed offset planes at different heights sweep diagonally across a honey field with soft shadows. The top off-white angled plane is a recognisable sophisticated PUBLIC WEBSITE with editorial imagery and 'aohys' UI; the middle pale olive plane is a recognisable CONTENT EDITOR with tidy fields, text lines and small image thumbnails; the bottom apricot plane carries an intentional precise CONNECTED DATA/DELIVERY DIAGRAM, not decorative dots. Hairline brown linking pins align a few meaningful points between layers. Realistic layered edges, matte ceramic, subtle warm translucent material only at joins, precise directional studio light. Broad composition: layer sections and partial cutaways show how these three surfaces relate. This is a purpose-built anatomical illustration of a real software system, not a random abstract blob, floating UI cards, machinery fantasy, spheres or generic technology sculpture. Each physical surface must contain recognisable software information. A small overlay keyed to the layers says 'Experience', 'Content', 'Delivery', and caption 'AOHYS · Public site & publishing'. The image bleeds toward the top and bottom, some sculptural edges cross subtly into white space, no bounding card, no rounded mock-browser container.
RIGHT ~280px on neutral white: heading 'Selected work', then SIX exact names as an elegant spacious vertical project index with tiny distinctive image crops next to each (not logos only): 'ETERIA' / 'The Barber Central' / 'NutriPlan' / 'Casa Roca' / 'Enterprise Product Systems' / 'AOHYS'. Tiny descriptive second lines respectively 'Events & proposals', 'Services & booking', 'Clinical operations', 'Hospitality', 'Enterprise workflows', 'Public site & practice'. No invented metrics. Active AOHYS has an olive underline and discreet arrow. All six visible and legible; none omitted.
3. Lower 210px visible section, beginning y810: substantial clean white architecture preview with brown headline 'What sits behind the interface.' Alongside a precise horizontal structural diagram 'Public site → Content graph → Publishing' and separate small 'Private workspace' label. 'Explore the architecture ↗' link clearly readable. It is a website section beginning below the hero, not a second full-page scene. A discrete small 'Concept study' in lower corner.

PALETTE: neutral white #FFFFFF, warm brown ink #473C33, golden honey #FEC868, olive #ABC270, apricot #FDA769. Use vivid LARGE areas of these exact relationships in the original sculpture while keeping navigation/type on white. No blue, purple, cyan or neon brand. No beige or cream page. No hard brutal shadows. No generic gradient backgrounds, no glassmorphism cards, no stock illustration of people, no leaves borrowed from other products. Rich original imagery and purposeful detail are the main source of personality.
Everything beautifully typeset and proportioned at professional digital studio quality. No slogans like 'crafting digital experiences', no metrics/revenue/outcomes, no coding terminal or tech badges, no fake testimonial. All UI on the sculpture is conceptual visualisation, not evidence or a claim of real deployed screens. Preserve truthful case scope, software recognisability and human first-person voice.
scope: Concept image; generated interfaces and diagrams are not evidence of implementation.
